author: Esfandyar Batmanghelidj
title: Commission artist for annual report cover $2500
content:
The @BourseBazaarFdn is looking to commission an emerging artist from West and Central Asia to create an original artwork that will feature on the cover of the foundation's forthcoming annual report.

The honorarium is $2,500. 

See how to apply here:
https://www.bourseandbazaar.org/opportunities/call-for-artists-annual-report-2026
